deploy-bot: Request: CoralBridge private deployment -> on-prem cluster (apac-1). Window: 2026-08-14 18:00-19:30 UTC. Image pinned to v4.0.0 (sha: 9c0ab7). Canary plan: 1% -> 8% -> 40% -> 100% with 12m checks. Rollback target: v3.9.7-locked. Runbook: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/coralbridge-onprem

alice (eng-release): Summary: DB schema migration included in release. Migration runs in two steps: pre-copy and final sync during the 2nd canary. Pre-copy will run 30m before cutover to reduce final downtime. Please confirm final sync timing and backup plan.

ben (sre): SRE: p95 target <= 150ms, errors <0.7%. Concern: pre-copy volume may increase IO on the on-prem DB cluster. Need maintenance window with ops and a snapshot beforehand. Runbook step 2 has snapshot command; ensure ops can do that.

hema (pm): Product note: CoralBridge asked that we keep default prompt templates and retain legacy model variants in the fallback chain. They also requested a 20-minute rollback decision window after the 40% shift. Add to checklist.

kai (cs): CS: CoralBridge ops confirmed snapshot and backup at 17:15 UTC. They also requested a short redirect for API endpoint for 5 minutes during final sync. We'll coordinate with their infra.

security-bot: Checked key material: customer KMS binding OK. Note: on-prem agent requires certificate thumbprint rotation to match corporate CA; rotation scheduled 2026-08-14 16:00 UTC (before window) so fine. Recommend ensuring agent certs are verified after rotation.

alice (eng-release): Auto-rollback gates: p95 latency, error rate, 5xx rate, and database replication lag. If DB replication lag > 5s for two checks, rollback to v3.9.7-locked. Rollback command registered with deploy-bot.

deploy-bot: Rollback example: redwood-deploy rollback --tenant=coralbridge --to=v3.9.7-locked --reason=canary-gate. Auto-rollback will fire if gates breached twice.

ben (sre): I'll be oncall. We will also run a synthetic traffic spike after 40% step to validate throughput. If spike causes >2x p95 increase, we will trigger rollback.

hema (pm): I'll run go/no-go at 17:30 UTC and join the thread. CoralBridge requires a 30-minute post-deploy validation window before final confirmation.

kai (cs): I'll publish release notes to the customer channel 60m prior and prepare the API redirect plan with their infra team.

deploy-bot: Reminder: reply "approve" to lock the window. Go/no-go ping scheduled at 17:30 UTC to @hema (pm), @kai (cs), @ben (sre), @alice (eng-release).

alice (eng-release): approve (locking window).

ben (sre): approve.

security-bot: approve from security. Recommend post-deploy audit /audit/run coralbridge-2026-08-14.
